title: Prismara
description: This is an su mod that adds gems.
body:
The mod aims to bring the Diamond Empire from Steven Universe and its colonies to Minecraft, incorporating gems, nurseries, planets, and structures from the series, video games, and content that didn't make it into the original show but was created by the show's original creators.

Disclaimer: This is a completely new mod. This mod is not based on the code of Gempire or Kagic; however, it is inspired by both, and there will be similarities in models, textures, and mechanics; If you haven't tried any of those mods, below I've included links to some mods I created, as well as the Gempire and Kagic mods.

The mod is still in a development phase, some things may have bugs or not work, but this will be corrected in the following snapshots or beta, until the alpha version is ready.

In this process it is very important that you support by commenting on what bugs exist in the game. Bugs that the developer may not have seen or been aware of.
